title: Design system preview: demos on another host read at their public address; Light | Dark in the Add site popup; Tracy Base and SaaS EmDash measurements in the image
steps: S1: Ask the Add site preview door for a demo row on host fleet01 (this server dev) whose <label>.fleet01-sites.tracy.site name throws and whose public address serves the home.
S2: Ask the same door for a demo on this host.
S3: Ask the door for the EmDash Tracy Business demo (two modes), then open the Add site popup on a two-mode page and press Dark.
S4: Run the design system readiness check on Tracy Base EmDash 0.5.4 and Tracy SaaS EmDash 1.4.14 from the tree, and read apps/tracy-web/Dockerfile.
expect: S1: 200 HTML, only the public address fetched.
S2: 200, read on its container only.
S3: the page carries x-tracy-ds-modes: both, also when kept; the popup shows Light | Dark and the framed page root gets data-theme=dark; a one-look page shows no switch.
S4: every built-site rule measured and passing; every EmDash theme with contracts has its COPY line into src/contracts/<slug>/emdash-0.x.
evidence: 14/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: every fleet01 demo answered 409 DEMO_UNREADABLE; the Add site popup of EmDash Tracy Business showed Desktop | Mobile only; /ops showed Tracy Base EmDash 0.5.4 C 5/13 not measured yet
fence: Door, reader and Dockerfile tests in node; the Add site popup's switch is covered by the plugin's Playwright e2e (design-system-card.test.mjs), not run by this case
